text:
Maya: Reminder — overnight freeze tonight 00:00–06:00 UTC. Canary rollout scheduled at 00:15. Please confirm pins and raise any critical hotfix asks by 23:30 UTC. Ops Lead will own emergency unpin/rollback.
Cheng: Pinning router-service @ v3.2.1 to canary and staging lanes now. No DB migrations in this release.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary start 00:15 UTC. Plan: 5% at T0, 25% at T+10m if healthy, 100% at T+30m.
Anna: Quick question — what's the emergency unpin flow if we see a backend spike? who triggers?
Maya: Emergency unpin requires Ops Lead + an eng-sre ack. Steps we use: 1) Ops Lead runs the unpin script, 2) SRE validates traffic backfill, 3) rollback owner watches metrics for 10m.
Maya: Command for unpin (auth required): `./scripts/unpin.sh --service router-service --tag v3.2.1 --env prod`
Ops Lead: I can act as unpin owner tonight. If triggered ping me in #eng-oncall and call the SRE channel.
Sam QA: Smoke checklist queued: /health, /generate (smoke prompt), embeddings probe, and tail app logs for 5m. I'll be ready for the T0 smoke.
Cheng: If we need a rollback instead of unpin, owner is the deployment primary (cheng). Rollback target: v3.2.0 pinned to canary.
Oncall-Bot: oncall-bot reminder: run pre-freeze canary smoke at 23:50 UTC.
Anna: Any tolerable degradation threshold? I'd prefer to set canary abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increases > 150ms over baseline.
Maya: Agreed. Canary abort rules: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 +150ms OR error surge in embeddings. Those are hard aborts.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot note: if canary aborts, automatic rollback to pinned version will not be performed — manual rollback trigger required from rollback owner.
Ops Lead: We'll keep a 15-minute warm window after each stage to validate telemetry. If emergency unpin is executed, we will notify infra and customer-success.
Sam QA: I'll post the smoke results to the thread at T+2m after canary start.
Cheng: A couple of housekeeping items: release notes pushed to `/releases/2026-03-21/router-service.md` and ops runbook updated with unpin playbook.
Maya: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've done your checks. I'll do a final sweep at 23:40 UTC.
